Email.//: SendGrid sends when SendGrid:ApiKey is set; empty (locally) = emails are written to the console instead.

SMS.//: Twilio sends when its settings are set; empty (locally) = texts, with the code, are written to the console: use it to confirm a mobile number locally.

SignUp.//: UK-only sign-up. Deployed, the country comes from Cloudflare's CF-IPCountry header. DevelopmentCountry is local only: e.g. FR to see the refusal; empty = allowed.

AgeAssurance.//: The on-demand age check for sensitive posts: liveness, then Yoti's face estimate, with photo ID as the fallback. A real check runs when its settings are set; otherwise the stand-ins in Development answer below.

Liveness.//: The real head-turn check (YuNet) when set. The bjk-core setup downloads the model and sets this.

Yoti.//: Yoti's face age estimate when SdkId and PrivateKey (secret, the PEM text) are set, from the Yoti Hub. BaseUrl defaults to https://api.yoti.com/ai/v1.

Development.//: Local only: what the stand-ins answer. EstimatedAge 20 = photo ID needed, 15 = under 18, 0 = can't tell. LivenessPasses is used only without a liveness model.

Support.//: Where people ask for help, e.g. the 'Contact support' link after a failed age check (a mailto link until a ticketing system replaces it).

DataProtection.//: Leave Certificate empty locally (keys stored unencrypted, with a warning in the log). Required outside Development: a PFX certificate with its private key, as base64 (see Encryption in the README).

BootstrapEmails: <your email, once you've registered and confirmed it>
